name: Survey tile in Virgo
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 2.8 degrees south of the ecliptic in Virgo, imaged by SPHEREx 21 times in 7 visits over 57 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 40 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 2.4 days starting 2026-01-22, at wavelengths from 1.36 to 4.98 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
